Locally uniform singularity analysis of e^{-θz}(1-z)^{-θ} supplies μ_n=θ log n−θ−θ ψ(θ)+Oθ(1/n) and the signed macroscopic profile. The checker independently enumerates 51,024 weighted derangement instances and passes 5,658 exact assertions; enumeration does not replace the unrestricted proofs.

value.rationale: A motivated structural classification of component dependence in a classical species-sampling/permutation model: a fixed-size r-cycle count can correlate positively or negatively with the total number of components. The full classification for every θ>0, universal nontrivial fraction 1−exp(−1/θ), and signed n-scale dependence profile supply predictions for macroscopic cycle-size classes; these are neither a single small numerical improvement nor an arbitrary finite slice.
